scope: Read-only public native observation intake, before any fit or candidate classification.

ztf_request.constraints: 1 arcsecond contextual cone; no time, band, magnitude, NOBS or catflags cuts. Returned object IDs and every row/flag preserved; association not automatically established.

storage: Fresh versioned files and headers/hashes; failed or error payloads retained. Never overwrite original observations.
admission: No annual-parallax likelihood, invented error/covariance, position or mass inferred by this intake.
